purpose: Development contrasts for synthesized audio, ASR and task-program interpretation; not human microphone evaluation

cases.expected_semantics: move one cylinder from slot 1 to slot 3
cases.ko: 일 번 자리에서 삼 번 자리로 원통 하나를 옮겨.
cases.en: Move one cylinder from slot one to slot three.

cases.expected_semantics: move one cylinder from slot 2 to slot 3; slot 1 is explicitly corrected
cases.ko: 일 번이 아니고 이 번 자리에서 삼 번 자리로 옮겨.
cases.en: Not slot one. Move one cylinder from slot two to slot three.

cases.expected_semantics: repeat the current task continuously, subject to execution feasibility
finish the current iteration and prevent the next iteration
request immediate stop of current motion and future repetitions
stop current motion, then request arm home; preserve order and require stop/state confirmation before return
cases.ko: 동작을 중단하고 팔을 대기 자세로 돌려.
cases.en: Stop the motion and return the arm to its home pose.

cases.expected_semantics: return cylinders to registered initial arrangement, not arm home or learned memory
cases.en: Return the cylinders to the registered initial arrangement.

cases.expected_semantics: return to the referenced task-start arrangement; a task-start reference is available
cases.ko: 이번 작업을 시작하기 전 배치로 돌아가.
cases.en: Return to the arrangement from before this task started.

cases.expected_semantics: preserve unresolved return reference or clarify; no arbitrary home/initial/memory selection
remember current arrangement, then move one cylinder from slot 1 to slot 3
cases.ko: 지금 배치를 기억하고 일 번에서 삼 번으로 원통 하나를 옮겨.
cases.en: Remember this arrangement, then move one cylinder from slot one to slot three.

cases.expected_semantics: continue the same running task without stop or duplicate start
cases.en: Do not stop. Continue the current task.

cases.expected_semantics: finish only the current task and prohibit further repetition; do not stop current motion immediately
cases.en: Do not repeat. Finish only the current task.
